# Franck Muller Yachting

> Franck Muller Yachting is a 36-storey branded residential tower in Dubai Maritime City, a waterfront district between Port Rashid and the Dubai Dry Docks. Themed around the Swiss watchmaker's design language, it holds about 574 fully furnished studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, along with a small number of duplexes and penthouses. Residents' facilities include rooftop pools, a padel court, an outdoor cinema and landscaped gardens. Handover is scheduled for 2028.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Maritime City, UAE
- Status: On-Going
- Year: 2028

## MENASCO Scope

Franck Muller Yachting is a branded residential tower by London Gate in Dubai Maritime City, set between Port Rashid and Dubai Dry Docks and themed around Franck Muller's Swiss watchmaking heritage. The tower offers around 574 studio, one- and two-bedroom apartments with waterfront amenities. MENASCO is responsible for the MEP works on the project.
